svg.title: BarangayPOB-3A ERD
svg.desc: MySQL Workbench-style entity relationship diagram for the existing BarangayPOB-3A database.
svg.text: Existing MySQL schema ? PK primary key ? FK foreign key ? UK unique key
Each relationship is one-to-many: one parent row may have zero or many child rows; nullable foreign keys allow an unlinked child.
AUDIT_LOGS.entity_type + entity_id are a polymorphic reference, not an enforced foreign key. Source: database/barangay_dashboard.sql
